q: In Romans, Paul says God works all things together for the good of whom?
why: They are called by His purpose.
quote: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him

q: In Romans, Paul says God works how many things together for good?
why: Even hard times are in His hands.
quote: God works all things together for the good

q: Complete Paul's words to the Romans: “If God is for us, who can be…”
why: No one can defeat God's people.
quote: If God is for us, who can be against us?

q: In Romans, Paul says that in all troubles we are more than what?
why: It is through Him who loved us.
quote: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.

q: In Romans, Paul says nothing in all creation can separate us from what?
why: God's love in Christ holds us fast.
quote: will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

q: In Romans, Paul says the Spirit helps us when we don't know how to do what?
quote: For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us

q: In Romans, Paul says there is now no condemnation for those who are where?
quote: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

q: In Romans, Paul says the Spirit testifies with our spirit that we are what?
quote: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.

q: In Romans, Paul writes that all have sinned and fall short of what?
quote: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God

q: In Romans, Paul says God proved His love because Christ died for us while we were what?
quote: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

q: In Romans, Paul says the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is what?
why: It comes in Christ Jesus our Lord.
quote: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

q: In Romans, what does Paul say we must confess with our mouth to be saved?
quote: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,”

q: In Romans, Paul says everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be what?
quote: Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.

q: In Romans, Paul quotes, “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring…”
quote: How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!

q: In Romans, Paul says faith comes by what?
why: Hearing comes through the word of Christ.
quote: Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.

q: In Romans, Paul urges believers to offer their bodies as what?
quote: to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God

q: In Romans, Paul says be transformed by the renewing of what?
quote: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

q: In Romans, how does Paul tell believers to overcome evil?
quote: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

q: In Romans, Paul says rejoice with those who rejoice and do what with those who weep?
quote: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.

q: In Romans, Paul says be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, and persistent in what?
quote: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.

q: In Romans, Paul says that in Christ we who are many are one what?
why: Each member belongs to the others.
quote: so in Christ we who are many are one body

q: In Romans, what does Paul call the fulfillment of the law?
why: Love does no wrong to a neighbor.
quote: Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.

q: In Romans, Paul says he is not ashamed of what?
why: It is God's power for salvation.
quote: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation

q: In Romans, Paul quotes that who believed God and was counted righteous?
quote: Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

q: In Romans, Paul says that since we are justified through faith, we have what with God?
why: It comes through our Lord Jesus Christ.
quote: we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ

q: In Romans, Paul quotes that no one is what, not even one?
quote: There is no one righteous, not even one.

q: In Romans, Paul says, if possible, live at peace with whom?
quote: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.

q: To believers in which city did Paul write the letter of Romans?
quote: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints

q: Who wrote down Paul's letter to the Romans for him?
quote: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.

q: In Romans, Paul commends Phoebe, a servant of the church in which place?
quote: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church in Cenchrea.

q: In Romans, what word does Paul say we cry out to God by the Spirit of sonship?
quote: by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

q: In Romans, Paul says suffering produces perseverance, which produces what?
quote: perseverance, character; and character, hope.

q: In Romans, Paul says we were buried with Christ through baptism so we may walk in what?
why: Christ was raised from the dead.
quote: we too may walk in newness of life.

q: In Romans, which couple does Paul greet as his fellow workers?
quote: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus

q: In Romans, Paul says God's children are co-heirs with whom?
quote: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ

q: In Romans, Paul says present sufferings cannot compare to what?
quote: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
